🤲 Duah of the Day

رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا بِمَا أَنزَلْتَ وَاتَّبَعْنَا الرَّسُولَ فَاكْتُبْنَا مَعَ الشَّاهِدِينَ

Our Lord, we have believed in what You revealed and have followed the messenger, so register us among the witnesses.

Surah Ali 'Imran 3:53

📚 Tafsir of the Duah

The disciples of Isa affirming belief in what Allah revealed and following the messenger.

📜 Hadith of the Day

مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ

Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak good or remain silent.

Sahih al-Bukhari 6018 · Sahih Muslim 47

💡 Explanation of the Hadith

The Prophet ﷺ links faith in Allah and the Last Day to the simple act of controlling one's tongue. Speech is a tremendous trust — a few careless words can destroy relationships, spread rumours or cause lasting harm. This hadith teaches that a believer should either speak good (truth, kindness, benefit) or remain silent. Silence is not weakness; it is a form of worship that protects the believer from sin. The Prophet ﷺ also said: 'Whoever guards his tongue, Allah will conceal his faults.'
